scenario: Check-in Alert → Coach Notification + CRM Flag
trigger: POST from /api/checkin when healthScore <= 7 (orange or red)
description: Fires whenever a student submits a weekly check-in with a health score of 7 or below. Make.com notifies the assigned coach via Discord DM, posts to the off-track-students channel with context, updates the GHL contact with a flag, and logs the alert to the coaching CRM sheet.

payload.coachDiscordId: string | null — Discord user ID of assigned coach (if available)
payload.flags: string[] — array of context strings (struggled, needs from coach, etc.)
payload.timestamp: string — ISO 8601 timestamp of check-in submission

makeSteps: Step 1: Receive webhook — check severity field
Step 2 (red): Send urgent Discord DM to coach — student needs immediate attention
Step 2 (orange): Send lower-priority Discord DM to coach — flag for this week's check-in
Step 3: Post to off-track-students Discord channel with student name + score + flags
Step 4: Search GHL contact by student name/email — add 'at-risk' tag
Step 5: Append row to Coaching CRM Google Sheet (student, score, week, severity, timestamp)
Step 6 (red): Set a follow-up task in GHL for coach to call within 24 hours
